issues.explanation: Printed form «پس انتشار» uses a space rather than ZWNJ; Rule 4 instructs to keep official forms as printed even if unusual, so the space form is retained correctly. No change needed — noted for awareness only.
issues.suggested_fix: No change; the proposed entry faithfully reproduces the printed spacing.

issues.explanation: The definition_fa correctly carries two separate, attributed definitions (INSO 23681 §3.3.2 and INSO 23683 §3.1.4), but editor_note_fa only names «INSO 23681 بند 3.3.2». The note is therefore incomplete and could mislead a downstream editor into thinking the INSO 23683 sense is missing.
issues.suggested_fix: Expand editor_note_fa to: «اصطلاح تعریف‌شده در INSO 23681 بند 3.3.2 و INSO 23683 بند 3.1.4؛ بازبینی‌نشده.»

issues.explanation: The printed term-header is «استفاده از هومص (هوش مصنوعی)», meaning the standard leads with the abbreviated form «هومص» and gives the full form as a parenthetical gloss. The proposed entry silently inverts this: it makes the full form the preferred_fa and relegates «هومص» to alternatives_fa, while leaving the acronym field empty. Under Rule 1, the preferred_fa should match what the standard prints as its primary head-term, which is the abbreviated form. At minimum, the acronym field must be populated.
issues.suggested_fix: Set acronym to «هومص». Either (a) keep preferred_fa as «استفاده از هوش مصنوعی» (full form, acceptable if the book consistently expands acronyms as preferred terms) and move «استفاده از هومص» from alternatives_fa into the alternatives field while setting acronym = «هومص»; or (b) to be strictly faithful to the printed head-term, set preferred_fa = «استفاده از هومص» and alternatives_fa = [«استفاده از هوش مصنوعی»]. Either way the acronym field must not be empty.
